rules.description: Replace the malformed generated lower_resolved_type_memory helper with a compile-safe version.
rules.replacement:
fn lower_resolved_type_memory(ty: &ResolvedType) -> ResolvedType {
    match ty {
        ResolvedType::Ptr { .. } => ResolvedType::Int(IntSize::I64),
        ResolvedType::Array(inner, size) => ResolvedType::Array(Box::new(lower_resolved_type_memory(inner)), *size),
        ResolvedType::Slice(inner) => ResolvedType::Slice(Box::new(lower_resolved_type_memory(inner))),
        ResolvedType::Tuple(types) => ResolvedType::Tuple(types.iter().map(lower_resolved_type_memory).collect()),
        ResolvedType::Option(inner) => ResolvedType::Option(Box::new(lower_resolved_type_memory(inner))),
        ResolvedType::Result(ok, err) => ResolvedType::Result(Box::new(lower_resolved_type_memory(ok)), Box::new(lower_resolved_type_memory(err))),
        ResolvedType::Ref { mutable, inner } => ResolvedType::Ref { mutable: *mutable, inner: Box::new(lower_resolved_type_memory(inner)) },
        ResolvedType::Function { params, ret, effects } => ResolvedType::Function { params: params.iter().map(lower_resolved_type_memory).collect(), ret: Box::new(lower_resolved_type_memory(ret)), effects: effects.clone() },
        ResolvedType::Struct(name, fields) => ResolvedType::Struct(name.clone(), fields.iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), v.clone())).collect()),
        ResolvedType::Enum(name, variants) => ResolvedType::Enum(name.clone(), variants.iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), v.clone())).collect()),
        _ => ty.clone(),
    }
}
rules.notes: This folds the remaining resolved-type drift into one controlled helper.

rules.description: Replace malformed resolved_to_ast_type with a compile-safe mapping that uses current field names.
rules.replacement:
fn resolved_to_ast_type(res: &ResolvedType, span: Span) -> Type {
    match res {
        ResolvedType::Int(_) => Type::Named { name: "Int".to_string(), generics: vec![], span },
        ResolvedType::Float(_) => Type::Named { name: "Float".to_string(), generics: vec![], span },
        ResolvedType::Bool => Type::Named { name: "Bool".to_string(), generics: vec![], span },
        ResolvedType::String => Type::Named { name: "String".to_string(), generics: vec![], span },
        ResolvedType::Unit => Type::Unit(span),
        ResolvedType::Struct(name, _) => Type::Named { name: name.clone(), generics: vec![], span },
        ResolvedType::Enum(name, _) => Type::Named { name: name.clone(), generics: vec![], span },
        ResolvedType::Ptr { mutable, inner } => Type::Ptr {
            mutable_: *mutable,
            inner: Box::new(resolved_to_ast_type(inner, span.clone())),
            provenance: PointerProvenance::LoweredRef,
            span,
        },
        ResolvedType::Ref { mutable, inner } => Type::Ref {
            mutable_: *mutable,
            inner: Box::new(resolved_to_ast_type(inner, span.clone())),
            lifetime: None,
            span,
        },
        ResolvedType::Slice(inner) => Type::Slice(Box::new(resolved_to_ast_type(inner, span.clone())), span),
        ResolvedType::Array(inner, size) => Type::Array(Box::new(resolved_to_ast_type(inner, span.clone())), *size, span),
        ResolvedType::Tuple(items) => Type::Tuple(items.iter().map(|item| resolved_to_ast_type(item, span.clone())).collect(), span),
        _ => Type::Named { name: "Any".to_string(), generics: vec![], span },
    }
}
rules.notes: This removes lingering `mutable_` field drift from the resolved-type to AST-type bridge.
